title: Skill Dreaming: Evolving Repository Skills through Pull Request Streams
abstract: arXiv:2610.36188v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on reusable skills for complex software engineering tasks, making skill libraries essential for repository development and maintenance. However, repository-specific skills must evolve with changing code structures, implementation conventions, and maintenance requirements. Pull requests (PRs) provide a natural source of such knowledge by recording how repositories evolve through implementation and review. Meanwhile, new PRs must follow repository-specific implementation patterns, modify related components consistently, and ensure that existing tests continue to pass while adding coverage for new functionality. This creates a mutually reinforcing cycle: PRs provide knowledge for updating skills, while these skills improve future PRs, maintain repositories, and support further skill evolution. translated_title: 技能梦境：通过拉取请求流演化仓库技能
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体在复杂的软件工程任务中越来越依赖可复用的技能，这使得技能库对于仓库的开发与维护至关重要。然而，针对特定仓库的技能必须随着代码结构、实现规范和维护需求的变化而不断演化。拉取请求记录了仓库在实现与审查过程中的演变，为此类知识提供了天然的来源。同时，新的拉取请求必须遵循仓库特定的实现模式，一致地修改相关组件，并确保在为新功能添加测试覆盖的同时，现有测试仍能继续通过。这就形成了一个相互增强的循环：拉取请求为技能更新提供知识，而这些技能又能改进未来的拉取请求、维护仓库，并支持技能的进一步演化。为了实现拉取请求、仓库和技能的这种共同演化，我们提出了 Skill Dreaming，一个框架……
tldr: 提出了 Skill Dreaming 框架，以拉取请求流为知识来源，实现拉取请求、仓库与技能库的共同演化，使仓库专属技能随代码库的变化持续更新并反哺未来的 PR 实践。
en_tdlr: Proposes Skill Dreaming, a framework that uses pull request streams as a knowledge source to enable the co-evolution of PRs, repositories, and skills, allowing repository-specific skills to continuously evolve and in turn improve future PRs and maintenance.
